description: energydata.info is the open-source portal code for a catalogue of energy-related datasets. Its repository README documents a local Vagrant and submodule-based development setup and configuration of the application. A deployed instance lets users find energy-resource, access and planning datasets contributed by providers; this repository is the portal software, not a single verified dataset. Geographic coverage depends on records indexed by a particular deployment. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the code, while each listed dataset can carry its own rights and access conditions. A limitation is that this older repository's development stack may require maintenance, and catalogue entries do not guarantee a linked file remains accessible or current. The portal can help identify energy demand, generation or electrification inputs for infrastructure scenarios. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model performs optimisation, not indexing source data. No portal installation or dataset was downloaded.
